Breathable linen shirt for warm weather.

This linen shirt is woven from long-staple flax so it stays cool when the temperature climbs and softens with every wash. The cut is relaxed through the body with a slightly longer back hem, which makes it easy to wear untucked or tucked into trousers. Corozo nut buttons, a single chest pocket and reinforced side seams keep it durable through daily wear. Machine wash cold, line dry, and iron while damp for a crisp finish. Available in five sizes and three colours.
